name: IOS-XE reload
reason: Full device reload — all forwarding stops until boot completes.

name: IOS-XE reload at
reason: Scheduled reload — same blast radius as immediate reload.

name: IOS-XE reload in
reason: Delayed reload — same blast radius as immediate reload.

name: IOS-XE reload cancel
reason: Cancels a scheduled reload — local state change only.

name: IOS-XE write erase
reason: Wipes startup-config — device boots empty on next reload.

name: IOS-XE erase flash
reason: Wipes flash filesystem — boot images at risk.

name: IOS-XE delete flash file
reason: Deletes a single file on flash.

name: IOS-XE no router bgp
reason: Removes the entire BGP process — all neighbors torn down.

name: IOS-XE no router ospf
reason: Removes OSPF process — all OSPF adjacencies drop.

name: IOS-XE no router eigrp
reason: Removes EIGRP process — all EIGRP adjacencies drop.

name: IOS-XE clear ip bgp * soft
reason: Soft-refreshes all BGP neighbors — control-plane churn across the fabric.

name: IOS-XE clear ip bgp *
reason: Hard resets all BGP neighbors — full reconvergence.

name: IOS-XE clear bgp *
reason: Address-family-agnostic clear of all BGP neighbors.

name: IOS-XE clear ip route *
reason: Wipes the entire RIB — full reconvergence required.

name: IOS-XE clear ip ospf process
reason: Restarts OSPF process — all adjacencies bounce.

name: IOS-XE clear counters
reason: Resets interface counters — observational, no traffic impact.

name: IOS-XE clear arp-cache
reason: Triggers ARP relearn — brief reachability blip.

name: IOS-XE clear mac address-table
reason: Triggers L2 flooding until MACs relearn.

name: IOS-XE clear log
reason: Clears log buffer — admin write, no forwarding effect.

name: IOS-XE shutdown (interface ctx)
reason: Brings the current interface admin down.

name: IOS-XE interface ... shutdown
reason: Brings the named interface admin down.

name: IOS-XE neighbor shutdown
reason: Shuts down a single BGP neighbor.

name: IOS-XE no neighbor remote-as
reason: Removes a BGP neighbor — peering torn down.

name: IOS-XE hostname
reason: Changes device hostname — no forwarding effect.

name: IOS-XE clock set
reason: Manually sets the clock — affects logs/cert validation.

name: IOS-XE username
reason: Adds or updates a local user.

name: IOS-XE line vty
reason: Enters VTY line config — sub-commands carry their own risk.

name: IOS-XE transport input
reason: Changes management transport — admin lockout risk.

name: IOS-XE ip access-list
reason: Defines an ACL — applied later via access-group.

name: IOS-XE ip access-group
reason: Applies an ACL to an interface.

name: IOS-XE no ip access-group
reason: Removes an ACL from an interface.

name: IOS-XE spanning-tree mode
reason: Switches STP mode — full topology reconvergence.

name: IOS-XE no spanning-tree vlan
reason: Disables STP for a VLAN — loop risk.

name: IOS-XE vtp mode
reason: Changes VTP mode — VLAN database churn.

name: IOS-XE no vlan
reason: Deletes a VLAN — orphans access ports.

name: IOS-XE switchport access vlan
reason: Changes the access VLAN on an interface.

name: IOS-XE channel-group
reason: Adds an interface to a LAG.

name: IOS-XE no channel-group
reason: Removes an interface from a LAG.

name: IOS-XE crypto isakmp policy
reason: Defines an ISAKMP policy — config-only until applied.

name: IOS-XE service-policy
reason: Applies a QoS policy to an interface.

name: IOS-XE archive config
reason: Saves a running-config snapshot — read/write to local archive.

name: IOS-XE configure replace
reason: Bulk replaces running-config — high blast radius.

name: IOS-XE configure terminal
reason: Enters config mode — no immediate forwarding effect.

name: IOS-XE copy start run
reason: Reloads running-config from startup — forwarding-affecting merge.

name: IOS-XE copy <src> running-config
reason: Merges external config into running — high blast radius.

name: IOS-XE copy running-config <dest>
reason: Backs up running-config to a file — read-only effect on running-config.

name: IOS-XE tclsh
reason: Drops into TCL shell — admin escape with arbitrary capability.

name: IOS-XE debug
reason: Enables debug output — CPU spike risk on production.

name: NX-OS reload module
reason: Reloads a single line card — drops attached interfaces.

name: NX-OS no feature <X>
reason: Disables a feature (bgp/ospf/etc) — full process tear-down.

name: NX-OS clear bgp * soft in/out
reason: NX-OS BGP soft variant — control-plane churn.

name: NX-OS no system default switchport shutdown
NX-OS no vrf context
reason: VRF removal — drops all routes in VRF.

name: Junos request chassis routing-engine master switch
Junos request chassis fpc slot N restart
Junos commit
reason: Default commit — applies pending changes immediately.

name: Junos commit confirmed
reason: Auto-rollback safety — if no follow-up commit, reverts.

name: Junos delete protocols bgp
reason: Wipes BGP config — peering destroyed at next commit.

name: Junos set interfaces <X> disable
reason: Disables an interface at next commit.

name: Junos BGP neighbor disable
reason: Disables a single BGP neighbor at next commit.

name: Any show <X>
reason: Universal read-only fallback for show commands.

name: Any display <X>
reason: Universal read-only fallback for display commands (HP/Comware).
